text:
Type: square side table
Use: holding drinks, a lamp or books; living room, bedroom, kids' room
Style: minimalist, contemporary, modern
Materials: lacquered board with a smooth painted finish
Colors: bright green, saturated grass green
Shape: thick flat square top, four chunky square legs flush at the corners, simple block form, compact
Feel: cheerful, bold, playful, simple
Goes with: white or grey walls, white furniture, colorful textiles; kids' rooms, student rooms and playful living rooms
